mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crop_analysis ( user_id, region_id, recommended_crop_id, recommended_reason, cultivation_method, risk_summary, weather_summary, score, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{regionId}, #{recommendedCropId}, #{recommendedReason}, #{cultivationMethod}, #{riskSummary}, #{weatherSummary}, #{score}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ca.analysis_id, ca.user_id, ca.region_id, ca.recommended_crop_id, ca.recommended_reason, ca.cultivation_method, ca.risk_summary, ca.weather_summary, ca.score, ca.created_at, c.crop_name, r.full_region_name FROM crop_analysis ca INNER JOIN crop c ON ca.recommended_crop_id = c.crop_id INNER JOIN region r ON ca.region_id = r.region_id WHERE ca.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND ca.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
